entries.title: Raid Boss website synchronisation
entries.description: The raid status publisher now sends live status from PebbleHost to the NEXUS MC website API. Minecraft arena teleporting, boss rotations and automatic announcements remain available.

entries.title: Raid movement containment
entries.description: Boss and minion containment added to prevent mobs wandering outside the configured fighting radius.

entries.title: Automatic raid announcements
entries.description: Introduced scheduled raid opening announcements and countdown-triggered automatic encounters.

entries.title: The road to Legendary begins
entries.description: Milestone progression up to level 900 with the Legendary tag reward.
